use_cases: Landing page hero sections with animated headline text and gradient backgrounds
Product or feature showcases with staggered text reveal animations
Portfolio and creative showcase pages with directional transform effects
SaaS landing pages with animated gradients and scroll-triggered content reveals
Marketing pages requiring visually engaging hero sections with motion effects
ai_summary: A highly animated hero component featuring gradient backgrounds (blue, black, and custom color options), staggered text animations, and directional transform effects. Built with Framer Motion for smooth transitions and scroll-triggered reveals. Supports multiple gradient positions, sizes, and color configurations with class-variance-authority for variant management. Ideal for creating visually striking landing page heroes with professional motion design.
